description: List the available SKUs supported by Microsoft.Storage for given subscription.

operations.description: Lists the available SKUs supported by Microsoft.Storage for given subscription.

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Get the list result of storage SKUs and their properties.
The capability information in the specified SKU, including file encryption, network ACLs, change notification, etc.
The name of capability, The capability information in the specified SKU, including file encryption, network ACLs, change notification, etc.
props.name: name

props.description: A string value to indicate states of given capability. Possibly 'true' or 'false'.
props.name: value
capabilities

props.description: Indicates the type of storage account.
props.name: kind

props.description: The set of locations that the SKU is available. This will be supported and registered Azure Geo Regions (e.g. West US, East US, Southeast Asia, etc.).
props.name: locations

props.description: The SKU name. Required for account creation; optional for update. Note that in older versions, SKU name was called accountType.
props.name: name

props.description: The type of the resource, usually it is 'storageAccounts'.
props.name: resourceType

props.description: The restrictions because of which SKU cannot be used. This is empty if there are no restrictions.

The reason for the restriction. As of now this can be "QuotaId" or "NotAvailableForSubscription". Quota Id is set when the SKU has requiredQuotas parameter as the subscription does not belong to that quota. The "NotAvailableForSubscription" is related to capacity at DC.
props.name: reasonCode

props.description: The type of restrictions. As of now only possible value for this is location.
props.name: type

props.description: The value of restrictions. If the restriction type is set to location. This would be different locations where the SKU is restricted.
props.name: values
restrictions

props.description: The SKU tier. This is based on the SKU name.
props.name: tier
value

responses.description: OK -- List of storage SKUs in the given subscription retrieved and returned successfully.
